title: Sequential determination of calcium chemical phases in gypsum-associated fluorite ores using ICP-OES
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4383-4391
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07208E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiao Wang, Na Guo, Liming Gan, Jiuffen Liu, Xin Wei, Tao He
This study aims to separate CaSO4, CaCO3, and CaF2 in gypsum-associated fluorite deposits. We developed a method for sequential determination of calcium chemical phases by ICP-OES, which provide insights for theoretical research of such deposits.
